dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Clynes's device isn't as useful as he claims it is... But there are four of you.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: In that case, it would be best if I knew nothing about any of this. In fact, it must be something I dream up while sleeping in my lovely soft bed.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: *cough* Estienne wrote the incident report. I don't know what happened. I just found a new place to take a beautiful nap.
